en: This old worker left gaps on purpose.
Small gaps between the rails.
Then a new boss arrived.
Gaps? This is lazy work!
I want a perfect railway!
Boss, iron needs room.
The boss just laughed.
He closed every single gap.
Then summer came. Fifty degrees!
In the heat, iron grows longer.
But now it had no room.
The rails pushed and pushed...
...and bent like a snake!
And the first train was coming.
With the boss on board.
Stop the train!
It stopped just in time...
...and the boss flew into the sand.
Iron needs room, boss.
Since that day, the gaps stayed.
That's why old trains go tak-tak.

en: This old cook kept a smelly jar.
A jar full of fish oil.
The captain hated the smell.
Throw that jar into the sea!
The cook hid it under his bed.
That night, a storm hit.
Huge waves broke over the ship.
We're going to sink!
The cook ran up with his jar...
...and poured the oil into the sea.
Are you cooking the sea?!
The oil spread, thinner than paper.
And the waves stopped breaking.
Old sailors really did this.
A little oil calms the waves.
The ship got through the storm.
Next morning, the captain called the cook.
